title: Shipwrecked: Nightmare at Sea
plot_overview: Never-before-seen footage and survivor accounts revisit a 2012 luxury cruise shipwreck and the disaster that followed. This immersive documentary examines the evacuation, the dangers faced by passengers and crew, and the decisions made during a chaotic emergency at sea.
will_you_like_this: You’ll like this if you value immersive survival documentaries built around firsthand accounts; Not for you if you prefer lighter viewing or less distressing real-world disasters.
review_summary: Pros: survivor accounts; immersive footage; gripping disaster story | Cons: intense subject matter; critical view of leadership; distressing events
